seoDescription: Urban Hearth is a woman-owned restaurant in Inman Square, Cambridge. Seasonal cooking rooted in New England.
statement: Urban Hearth is a woman-owned restaurant in Inman Square, Cambridge. We cook seasonal food, sourced from a close network of New England farmers, fishermen, and foragers. The dining room has been open since 2016.
farmsIntro: Our menu is shaped by the people who grow and raise the food. These are the farms and producers we work with most closely.
